title: CAT CATCHER
oneLiner: Guide a nimble cat across the rooftops to catch falling fish and dodge mischievous birds.
mechanics: Move the cat left and right along a rooftop.
Catch falling fish to score points.
More objects fall faster as time passes.
lose: The cat is hit three times by birds or flowerpots.
scoring: Each caught fish scores points, with bonus points for consecutive catches.
